segments.text: Same money. Two accounts instead of one. People saved more.
When your savings sit in one pile, dipping in is easy.
In one study of low-income consumers, splitting money set aside for a goal into two parts raised savings.
A visible reminder of the goal helped too.
So name one goal. Split its money into two separate parts. Then keep a picture of the goal where you'll see it.
Try it today: name one goal, and split its savings in two.
